newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close down led by major shares.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close down led by major shares.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed down in trading dominated by pocket-to-pocket dealing and sales of some of the country's leading shares, dealers said.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed down 0.28 percent at 18,080.64 pesos on an above-average trading volume of 4.4 billion pesos. Bogota's IBBindex slipped 0.54 percent to 1,188.74 on a volume of 1.7 billion pesos.
Brokers said large investors had taken advantage of general market apathy in order to make large pocket-to-pocket or so- called "cross trades."

Banco Ganadero, Colombia's largest bank in terms of assets, edged down 0.25 percent to 393 pesos on volume of 792 million in Bogota, and slipped 0.75 percent to 392 pesos on volume of 95 million in Medellin.
Brokers said shares in Ganadero, controlled by the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya were affected by several days of sales in the stock on Wall Street.
Giant brewer Bavaria fell 0.80 percent to 7,861 pesos on volume of 24 million in Bogota, and dropped 0.30 percent to 7,900 on volume of 372 million in Medellin.
